concerns.text: The execution log schema (execution_log.schema.yaml) requires fields `run_id`, `warning_codes`, and `timestamp`, but the plan only lists logging `task_id, success, total_calls, total_tokens, duration, status`. The plan must explicitly state that these required fields will be captured to satisfy the contract.

The evolved task schema (evolved_task.schema.yaml) expects a nested `task` object that conforms to the Task schema, yet the plan does not mention generating or validating this `task` sub‑object. The plan should include steps to produce a full Task record (including `optimal_path_length`, `tool_diversity_k`, `features`, etc.) for each evolved task.
